environment: dirty local working tree and loopback synthetic preview
applicability_reason: Ley 11/2023 covers specified consumer services including e-commerce, but the final service, distance-contracting function and microenterprise status are not established. RD 193/2023 readiness is also time- and ownership-dependent.
expected: Resolve the covered-service and microenterprise questions, then test the complete applicable user flows with automation, keyboard, zoom/reflow and at least one relevant assistive technology.
observed: Sixteen focused accessibility/contact/legal contract tests pass and current screenshots show responsive layouts. No named screen-reader, 200/400 percent zoom, full keyboard, error-state or production-flow evidence was available in this sub-audit.
method: Focused local test execution, source review and visual screenshot inspection; official BOE verification of Ley 11/2023 and RD 193/2023.
limitations: No assistive-technology session or deployed production flow was tested.
The legal service category and microenterprise exception remain unresolved.
impact: Users of assistive technologies may encounter unobserved barriers, and legal scope cannot be closed from automated contracts alone.
prevalence: All locales and critical navigation/contact flows.
priority: P1 before public UAT; P0 if covered-service applicability is confirmed

source_refs.legal_effect: Spanish transposition establishing accessibility requirements for covered products and consumer services, subject to scope, exclusions and transition rules.
source_refs.applicability_reason: Potentially applies if the final site provides a covered consumer e-commerce service and no service microenterprise exception applies.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE ELI consolidated text, definition and microenterprise provision review.

source_refs.legal_effect: Spanish basic accessibility conditions for goods and services to the public with staged dates.
source_refs.applicability_reason: Readiness is relevant to a private service offered to the public, but ownership, new/existing status and transition dates require confirmation.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE ELI consolidated text and final-sixth schedule review.

false_positive_analysis: Passing source-contract tests and responsive screenshots are valuable counterevidence but do not demonstrate end-to-end accessibility or legal conformity.
counterevidence: Focused accessibility, contact and legal tests passed 16/16.
Responsive screenshot evidence exists for 1440, 1180, 780 and 390 pixel viewports in the product-design audit.
remediation_minimum: Resolve legal scope and run documented keyboard, zoom/reflow and screen-reader tests over every critical locale and contact/error state in an authorised staging build.
additional_hardening: Add accessibility acceptance evidence and defect retest IDs to the release gate rather than relying only on static contracts.
suggested_owner: Accessibility specialist, product owner and frontend engineering
retest: Use the same flow/locale matrix and preserve browser, viewport, assistive-technology version and evidence.
residual_risk: Moderate until manual assistive-technology and full-flow evidence exists.
